# Synthetic bank and payment-app messages for trying khata out.
#
# Every line here is invented: the amounts, merchants, account tails and
# reference numbers are made up, and no real message from anyone's phone is
# included. They reproduce the message *shapes* issued by major Indian banks
# and payment apps, which is what the parser actually keys on.
#
# Try it:  go run ./cmd/khata -ledger /tmp/demo.jsonl import testdata/sample_messages.txt
#          go run ./cmd/khata -ledger /tmp/demo.jsonl month
#
# Lines beginning with # are ignored.

# --- the same payment reported twice: bank SMS then app push ---------------
# Both carry reference 522345678915, so the ledger should keep exactly one.

Rs.250.00 paid to Blue Tokai Coffee using ICICI Bank ****4412 UPI Ref no 522345678915
